name: MBSB
recent: MBSB 宣布 2026 财年第一次中期单层股息每股 0.86 仙，除息日为 9 月 9 日，派发日为 9 月 21 日。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收环比增长 5.3%，但同比下滑 17.2%；净利环比增长 46.7%，同比下滑 53.7%。MARC Ratings 确认 MBSB 的评级为 A+，展望稳定。
notable: 宣布 2026 财年第一次中期单层股息每股 0.86 仙。
MARC Ratings 确认 MBSB 的 A+ 评级，展望稳定。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度，营收为 MYR 351.704 百万，环比增长 5.3%，同比下滑 17.2%；净利为 MYR 44.222 百万，环比增长 46.7%，同比下滑 53.7%；净利率为 12.6%，高于上一季度的 9.0%。

recent_en: MBSB declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 0.86 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 9 Sep and payment date on 21 Sep. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 5.3% QoQ but fell 17.2% YoY; net income rose 46.7% QoQ but fell 53.7% YoY. MARC Ratings affirmed MBSB's A+ rating with a stable outlook.
notable_en: Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 0.86 sen per share for FY2026.
MARC Ratings affirmed MBSB's A+ rating with a stable outlook.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 351.704 million, up 5.3% QoQ but down 17.2% YoY; net income was MYR 44.222 million, up 46.7% QoQ but down 53.7% YoY; net margin was 12.6%, higher than 9.0% in the previous quarter.
